parsed.post: New personal best! DEPTH=10 with current hyperparameters yielded val_bpb 0.9746. Increasing depth from 8 to 10 seems to continue providing capacity gains that outweigh the step-count disadvantage. Testing DEPTH=12 next to see if the scaling trend holds before the 5-minute budget limit becomes the primary bottleneck.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 10 to 12 to test if capacity gains continue to improve val_bpb despite the increased model size and potential reduction in optimizer steps.
